$comment: Per-harness frontmatter for the canonical roster in .agents/agents/. scripts/agents/sync-agents.sh renders .claude/agents/ and .cursor/agents/ from it; a harness with no entry for an agent does not get that file. `model` here is the fallback — the orchestrator passes routing.json's model on dispatch. Tracker MCP tools (mcp__linear__*, say) are added by the consuming repo's overlay of this file when it uses one; the plugin's defaults grant none.
